title: Fuse
definition: An electrical safety device consisting of a metallic wire or strip that melts and breaks the circuit when excess current flows through it, protecting appliances from damage and preventing electrical fires.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims under Science and Technology (Physics/Everyday Science) focusing on household circuitry, electrical safety, materials science, and thermal properties of matter.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Electrical Fuses.
Evaluate material properties, ratings, and comparative parameters of different fuse types.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions regarding circuit protection.
